changes: Fixed macOS window and popup behavior: the main window now opens cleanly maximized to the desktop on first launch and remembers fullscreen, maximized, or custom size across restarts; popups and consent dialogs stay cleanly draggable in custom frames with sharp Retina icons without stretching; closing Settings cleanly closes the window from fullscreen or desktop without leaving a blank frame or black screen; and changing UI scaling inside fullscreen Settings keeps focus without switching to the desktop.

Stabilized DaVinci Resolve Bridge and .bws project import: read-only timeline queries no longer switch the active timeline in Resolve, requests acknowledge immediately before execution, connection timeouts and watcher loops are smoothed out, Native and Bridge timeline fingerprints now match identically, and .bws exports bundle an FCPXML fallback preferred automatically under Bridge and Resolve Free 21.1+.
Preserved manual word markings made during chunked live transcription so edits applied while words stream in are never wiped when transcription finishes.
Restored and sped up debounced search across transcript Ctrl+F (precompiled matching + word cache), Settings search (cached folded entries + icons), and searchable dropdowns (fonts, languages).

Fixed the broken in-app Update button in Settings, fixed updater version detection on v4.x installs, fixed a display DPI font crash (QFont), and expanded opt-in automatic error reporting to cover updater and active Resolve Bridge failures with per-version deduplication.
